RecipeDef.label: induce artificial coma
RecipeDef.description: Induce a coma to halve new hypoxic brain injury while the underlying emergency is treated. Requires five industrial or glitterworld medicine. Herbal medicine is unsuitable. Wake-up reverses the induced state. Long coma carries its own neurological and fatal risks.

RecipeDef.label: reverse artificial coma with wake-up
RecipeDef.description: Administer one normal dose of wake-up to reverse an artificial coma. Its ordinary drug effects and risks still apply. This does not cure natural coma, brain damage or the underlying emergency.
